_pendingNote: Rows added 2026-11-16 for documents the Sept 2026 office batch actually delivered (four CY2025 supplemental budget ordinances, GAD AR CY2025, GAD PB FY2027, LDRRMF Jan-Jul 2026). They stay 'pending' because the files themselves are not in the repo: lgu/assets/reference docs/ is .gitignore'd. DILG FDP expects the actual document to be publicly posted, so to flip any of these to 'available' the file has to be committed (un-ignore just that file, or copy it into lgu/assets/contents/ which is tracked) and its path set as 'href' with spaces URL-encoded. The LDRRMF scan needs re-orienting first: its pages are landscape and alternate pages are scanned upside down.
_fdpNote: 2026-11-16: the Municipal Accounting Office supplied 20 FDP forms as a single 20-page scan. They were split one file per form per quarter into lgu/assets/contents/fdp/ and are linked individually, which is how DILG FDP expects them posted and lets a reader find one period without paging a bundle. The scans were NOT re-encoded: they are ~267 DPI CamScanner JPEGs of financial forms and legibility of the figures outranks the ~400 KB each. Source bundle checksum and the page-to-file mapping are in 'lgu/assets/reference docs/README.md'.
